problem_plain: Phase III clinical trials are extremely costly, ranging from 19 to over 100 million dollars per trial, and require faster execution with better risk management.
capability: Implementation of over 30 generative AI solutions using Workbench, a clinical trial accelerator that combines AI insights with real-time operational data to convert structured and unstructured data into actionable information with role-based recommendations.
scale_outcomes: Trials accelerated in months; faster reaction to emerging risks.
reusable: The Workbench platform approach combining AI insights with real-time operational data from transactional systems, role-based recommendations, and predictive analytics for risk anticipation could be adapted for other complex, data-intensive processes requiring accelerated delivery and risk management.
summary: BMS partnered with Veridane to deploy over 30 generative AI solutions across R&D, Global Product Development & Supply and Commercialization, with the flagship Workbench solution accelerating Phase III clinical trials. The solution combines AI insights with real-time operational data to anticipate problems and propose interventions, resulting in accelerated trials and faster risk response.
